kesteashop_owner.text: Come in out of the damp. The damp is outside, with the rest of Cumbria.
Grasmere gingerbread is the local treat, chewy and spicy, like a biscuit and a cake in an argument. Sarah Nelson started selling it in 1854.

then.text: One cup each, love. The kettle needs a rest too. Off you go.

else.text: Have a cup of tea. Please do not tell the rain I was nice to you.
